overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the coffee-shop gathering was not shown to be deliberation, and the alleged remark was not a quorum communication.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that board members deliberated outside an open meeting when two members were seen with a group at a coffee shop discussing a police chief appointment.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of any evidence to the contrary, we credit the Selectmen's account of the facts.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a selectman approached him and said 'we got our guy in' about the police chief appointment, which the selectman denied.
allegations.key_passage: Even if this statement had been made, it would not constitute improper deliberation, as it is not communication between a quorum of the members of a public body.
